description: Ask Fudge to do work for this store: build or revise a page, article or other draft, investigate, or answer a question. Without `ref`, starts a new conversation; with `ref`, continues that work. Uses the store’s Fudge credits. `requestId` makes retries deliver once. Publishing always needs the merchant’s own approval in Fudge.

message.description: The merchant’s request in full: what to do, for which page or products, and any decisions already made.

ref.description: fudge://thread/… or fudge://project/… to continue; omit to start new work.

requestId.description: A unique ID you choose for this request, e.g. a UUID. Retries reuse it.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

title.description: Short title for a new conversation.

name: message_fudge
title: Message Fudge
